name: Abdon
overview: Abdon was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified as the son of Jeiel and Maacah. He is noted as the firstborn, which highlights his position within his family lineage. Beyond these details, Scripture does not provide additional notes about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Abdon means 'servant,' reflecting a common Hebrew proper name of the period. This name is not indicated as being given directly by God but is recorded in 1 Chronicles 8:30.
familyAndRelationships: Abdon is explicitly recorded as the son of Jeiel and Maacah, establishing his immediate family ties. Scripture does not mention other relationships beyond this parental connection.
scriptureSignificance: Abdon's significance in the biblical narrative rests primarily on his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin. Being the firstborn son of Jeiel and Maacah situates him within the historical and tribal records of Israel, which are important for understanding lineage and tribal heritage. His mention in 1 Chronicles underscores the biblical emphasis on genealogies as part of God's providential plan for His people.
